## Ways to Expand This Project 💼📧🌙🎬

If you want to take ownership of this project, build the remaining sections from the design:

- Add a Selected Projects section
- Build a Technical Stack section
- Add a Contact section (want to talk about tools?)
- Finish with a Footer to close things off
